# Shruti 1.4.31
- Resize either mixer panel with its visible corner grip. Pointer movement stays stable as the window grows; double-click the grip to fit the current audio apps to the screen. Window sizing is saved when resizing ends. - Installed app categories no longer add silent, unused apps to the mixer. Real audio activity and retained user controls determine membership. Existing arrangements stay in order, and new activity does not automatically scroll away from the app you are using. - Remove an app directly with its row’s × button, including in Arrange. Undo and Add App → Removed restore its saved mix and order. - Eiosis AirEQ’s original editor now receives the initialization it requires. Plugin construction, saved-state restoration and parameter-state capture run away from the UI thread. Loading has a deadline and Retry; closed or removed editors cannot reappear from obsolete callbacks. - Native Audio Unit editors are preferred. A plugin without a usable native view has a clearly explained published-control recovery view. - Includes the 1.4.30 responsive faders, dB readouts, Shift fine adjustment, Clear Solo, ordered Smart controls and Global EQ improvements.
Requires macOS 14.2 or later; Apple silicon and Intel. Settings are preserved. Native editor checks covered installed Eiosis AirEQ Premium, Apple AUParametricEQ, Sonnox Oxford EQ and Slate Inf EQ. This does not certify every plugin or hardware route. No synthetic sound was played during verification.
